content: व्यवसायिन् {%a.%} .²1 Energetic, industrious, diligent; किं दूरं व्यवसायिनाम् <ls>Pt. 2. 51</ls>. .²2 Resolute, persevering; बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् <ls>Bg. 2. 41</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 248</ls>. .²3 Performing, doing, undertaking; (श्रेष्ठाः) ज्ञानिभ्यो व्यवसायिनः <ls>Ms. 12. 103</ls>. .²4 Engaged in any business or profession. --{%m.%} A tradesman, merchant.
